cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
def run(f, out):
    t0=time.time()
    with open(f,'rb') as fh, open(out,'wb') as oh:
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/app/submission/scheduler.py'],stdin=fh,stdout=oh)
    el=time.time()-t0
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    return el, ru.ru_maxrss/1024.0, p.returncode
print("burst", run('big_burst.json','bb.out'))
print("stream", run('big_stream.json','bs.out'))
EOF
ls -la /app/work/bb.out /app/work/bs.out
